reasoning: Recent Iowa polling in the last 45 days shows a very narrow Senate race rather than a clear lean: Emerson/Nexstar found Ashley Hinson ahead of Josh Turek by 3 points, while Fox News found Turek ahead by 4 points, leaving the race effectively near-even. Iowa’s statewide Cook Partisan Voting Index is R+7, which provides the structural Republican baseline even though the current Senate polling is competitive.

sources.name: The Hill reporting Emerson College Polling/Nexstar Media Iowa poll
sources.details: Emerson College Polling/Nexstar Media survey of 712 likely voters found Ashley Hinson at 48% and Josh Turek at 45% in Iowa’s U.S. Senate race.

sources.name: CBS2 Iowa reporting Emerson College Polling
sources.details: CBS2 Iowa reported the same Emerson poll showing Hinson at 47.5% and Turek at 45%, a 2.5-point Hinson lead within the margin of error.

sources.name: Newsweek reporting Fox News Iowa Senate poll
sources.details: Fox News polling reported in Newsweek found Josh Turek ahead of Ashley Hinson by 4 points, 50% to 46%, showing a Democratic lead in the same race.
